templates.name: Store Opening Checklist
templates.description: To be completed within 30 minutes of opening the shutter

questions.text: Shutter opened on time and entrance area swept
Signage, glow sign and window lights switched on
Photo of the store front after opening
All mannequins dressed as per the current VM guide
Trial rooms clean, mirrors wiped and hooks available
Number of staff present at opening
POS terminals, scanners and card machines working
Carry bag and invoice roll stock adequate

templates.name: Store Closing Checklist
templates.description: Complete before pulling down the shutter

questions.text: Day-end POS report generated and cash tallied
Folding and racks re-arranged by size
Trial rooms checked for left-behind garments
All lights, AC and escalators switched off
